text: Siemens AG is a Frankfurt-listed industrial group (MDAX/DAX-scale, Siemens family a long-standing minority holder) with no state shareholder. The Siemens family holding is personal and the rest is free float, so the Red Bull partnership is private corporate money. Human-rights exposure attaches to Siemens' own conduct and supply chains rather than any state owner.
short: Siemens AG is a Frankfurt-listed industrial group (MDAX/DAX-scale, Siemens family a long-standing minority holder) with no state shareholder.
